historical_record.description: Coronet Theatre, designed by A. Mackenzie Cantin.
The Coronet Theatre was completed. Construction had begun in 1941 and stopped during the Second World War with only the frame and foundation up.
The Coronet closed after fifty-six years as a single-screen cinema.
